gloss: to carefully select; to pick the very best

definitions.gloss: to carefully select; to pick the very best
definitions.explanation: To choose with great care from many, keeping only the best. Very often in the passive {選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}かれた before a noun: 'carefully selected, hand-picked'.

examples.japanese: {選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}かれた⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧。
⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧{選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}く。
examples.english: To pick out the ingredients one by one.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}いた⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{飲|の}める→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: At this bar you can drink sake the owner hand-picked from all over the country.

notes:
⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ + 〜⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to do thoroughly, to the end).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}かれた⟦{精鋭|せいえい}→精鋭：31509_seiei⟧: a hand-picked elite
- {選|えら}び{抜|ぬ}いた⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧: carefully selected materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{厳選|げんせん}→厳選：11865_gensen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to select carefully; more formal, common in advertising
- ⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose; the plain verb
